dct_description_sm:
This notice applies to owners of facilities that manufacture or use greater than 100 kg of bisphenol A per year (alone or in a mixture), release effluents containing bisphenol A, and are involved in the activities specified in the notice.

This notice has been in effect since April 14, 2012, for facilities who manufacture or use BPA. Although the initial facilities subject have completed their obligations, this notice is still in effect. This means that new facilities could become subject if they meet the requirement(s) of the notice. 

For more information, please refer to the Notice link provided below.
dct_title_s: Bisphenol A in industrial effluents - P2 Notice
